Wedding rings come in several popular styles, ranging from `simple metal bands to diamond-encrusted designs`.[[1]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)

### Popular Wedding Ring Styles

- **Classic Plain Bands:** A simple, unadorned circle of precious metal representing timeless elegance and pure commitment.[[1]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)
- **Eternity Rings:** Features a continuous line of identical gemstones (usually diamonds) set all the way around the band to symbolize infinite love. Half-eternity bands feature stones halfway around for easier everyday wear and resizing.[[1]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)
- **Comfort Fit Bands:** Designed with a rounded interior edge that makes sliding the ring over the knuckle and wearing it daily much smoother.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1907160401597948319,catalogid:6423170515116707821,gpcid:3292942611922972304,mid:576462822854900888&ibp=oshop)
- **Vintage-Inspired Rings:** Incorporates intricate details like milgrain texturing, filigree work, or antique engravings reminiscent of Art Deco or Victorian eras.[[1]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)
- **Contoured and Curved Bands:** Shaped with a slight curve or dip so they fit flush against an engagement ring with a prominent center stone.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)[[2]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)
- **Stacked and Mixed Metal Bands:** Multiple slender rings worn together or unique designs blending different metal tones like rose gold and platinum.[[1]](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/13-types-of-wedding-bands-a-complete-guide)[[2]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)

You can explore detailed styling tips and options directly through the [Brilliant Earth Guide to Wedding Rings](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/) or browse trends on [Orielle](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings).[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)[[2]](https://orielle.co/blogs/wedding-rings/types-of-wedding-rings)If you'd like to narrow down your choices, tell me:

- Who is the ring for (**men's, women's, or a matching set**)?
- Do you have a preferred **metal type** (yellow gold, white gold, platinum, or alternative metals like tungsten)?
- Are you pairing it with an **engagement ring**?
